title: Dental Implant Timeline: Start to Finish Guide for Patients
seoTitle: Dental Implant Timeline: From Consult to Final Crown
seoDescription: See every stage of implant treatment, how long each takes, and what adds months. Get a staged, CBCT-based timeline from our Valencia team.
excerpt: From imaging to final crown, implant treatment runs in stages. Learn the typical timing of each, why infection and bone change it, and what to ask before you start.
keyTakeaways: Treatment moves through consult and imaging, any prep work, implant placement, healing, and restoration.
Most single-tooth cases without major grafting take three to nine months from extraction to crown.
Infection at the site and low bone volume are the two most common reasons a timeline stretches.
Immediate placement at extraction is possible only when the socket is infection-free and the implant is stable.
Socket grafts usually need three to four months to mature; sinus lifts and larger grafts four to six or more.
